summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the vertical AI workflow node using a two-lane Serenity funnel. Palantir is retained only as the high-attention reference leader for AI operating-layer adoption in government and regulated enterprise workflows. The underfollowed lane emphasizes workflow-control, proprietary or high-friction data operations, and embedded AI inside regulated vertical systems: Innodata for AI data engineering and model-evaluation supply, Appian for regulated process orchestration, and CCC Intelligent Solutions for insurance-claims AI workflow penetration. These are research candidates, not trading recommendations.
